data.title: Covariance matrix recovery from one-bit data with non-zero quantization thresholds: algorithm and performance analysis
data.abstractNote: Covariance matrix recovery is a topic of great signiﬁcance in the ﬁeld of one-bit signal processing and has numerous practical applications. Despite its importance, the conventional arcsine law with zero threshold is incapable of recovering the diagonal elements of the covariance matrix. To address this limitation, recent studies have proposed the use of non-zero clipping thresholds. However, the relationship between the estimation error and the sampling threshold is not yet known. In this article, we undertake an analysis of the mean squared error by computing the Fisher information matrix for a given threshold. Our results reveal that the optimal threshold can vary considerably, depending on the variances and correlation coefﬁcients. As a result, it is inappropriate to adopt a constant threshold to encompass parameters that vary widely. To mitigate this issue, we present a recovery scheme that incorporates timevarying thresholds. Our approach differs from existing methods in that it utilizes the exact values of the threshold, rather than its statistical properties, to increase the estimation accuracy. Simulation results, including those of the direction-of-arrival estimation problem, demonstrate the efﬁcacy of the developed scheme, especially in complex scenarios where the covariance elements are widely separated.

data.title: Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces in 6G radio localization: a survey of recent developments, opportunities, and challenges
data.abstractNote: In this survey paper, we present an extensive review of the use of reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) in 6G radio localization, highlighting their pivotal role as a low-cost, energy-efficient technology that reshapes wireless communication and localization landscapes. Investigating the versatile capabilities of RIS, we explore their dynamic control over electromagnetic wave manipulation, including reflection, refraction, and transmission, which opens new horizons in diverse applications ranging from Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity to advanced mobile communication, and various innovative applications in Industry 4.0. Our comprehensive review provides an overview of RIS use in 6G radio localization, highlighting recent progress in RIS technology assisted localization. It focuses on key aspects, including network scenarios, transmission bands, deployment environments, and near-field operations. We discuss studies to examine the state-of-the-art RIS-assisted localization and optimization techniques and their performance evaluation matrices. In addition, we present a detailed taxonomy of RIS-assisted radio localization, emphasizing the rapid evolution and potential of RIS technology in non-line-of-sight scenarios as an alternative to traditional base stations. Based on the careful investigation of the reviewed studies, the survey also sheds light on future research directions, technical challenges, and limitations, offering a clear perspective on the integration and optimization of RIS in 6G networks for enhanced localization capabilities.

data.title: A semantic-consistent few-shot modulation recognition framework for IoT applications
data.abstractNote: The rapid growth of the Internet of Things (IoT) has led to the widespread adoption of the IoT networks in numerous digital applications. To counter physical threats in these systems, automatic modulation classification (AMC) has emerged as an effective approach for identifying the modulation format of signals in noisy environments. However, identifying those threats can be particularly challenging due to the scarcity of labeled data, which is a common issue in various IoT applications, such as anomaly detection for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and intrusion detection in the IoT networks. Few-shot learning (FSL) offers a promising solution by enabling models to grasp the concepts of new classes using only a limited number of labeled samples. However, prevalent FSL techniques are primarily tailored for tasks in the computer vision domain and are not suitable for the wireless signal domain. Instead of designing a new FSL model, this work suggests a novel approach that enhances wireless signals to be more efficiently processed by the existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) FSL models. We present the semantic-consistent signal pretransformation (ScSP), a parameterized transformation architecture that ensures signals with identical semantics exhibit similar representations. ScSP is designed to integrate seamlessly with various SOTA FSL models for signal modulation recognition and supports commonly used deep learning backbones. Our evaluation indicates that ScSP boosts the performance of numerous SOTA FSL models, while preserving flexibility.

data.title: Applications of compressive sampling technique to radar and localization
data.abstractNote: During the last decade, the emerging technique of compressive sampling (CS) has become a popular subject in signal processing and sensor systems. In particular, CS breaks through the limits imposed by the Nyquist sampling theory and is able to substantially reduce the huge amount of data generated by different sources. The technique of CS has been successfully applied in signal acquisition, image compression, and data reduction. Although the theory of CS has been investigated for some radar and localization problems, several important questions have not been answered yet. For example, the performance of CS radar in a cluttered environment has not been comprehensively studied. Applying CS to passive radars and electronic warfare receivers is another concern that needs more attention. Also, it is well known that applying this strategy leads to extra computational costs which might be prohibitive in large-sized localization networks. In this chapter, we first discuss the practical issues in the process of implementing CS radars and localization systems. Then, we present some promising and efficient solutions to overcome the arising problems.

data.title: From classical to intelligent methods: a comprehensive survey of node localization algorithms and techniques in wireless sensor networks
data.abstractNote: The rapid advancement of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) has led to the development of a wide variety of localization techniques. This enables various tasks, such as environmental, health, and crop monitoring, etc. Researchers have proposed numerous approaches ranging from classical range-based and range-free methods to more recent machine learning and optimization-driven solutions. These contributions are often presented in isolation, making it difficult to obtain a unified understanding of their relative strengths and limitations. Therefore, there is a need of a comprehensive survey that systematically organizes existing localization techniques into a coherent framework. The paper presents an extensive survey of range-free, range-based, machine-learning-based, and metaheuristics-based techniques. Further, the surveyed methods are systematically classified based on mathematical models, accuracy, sensitivity, measurement models, anchor utilization, energy efficiency, and scalability, etc. This survey aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of localization techniques and future research directions in node localization in WSNs.

data.title: One-bit sparse array DOA estimation
data.abstractNote: One-bit quantization has become an important topic in massive MIMO systems, as it offers low cost and low complexity in the implementation. Techniques to achieve high performance in spite of the coarse quantizers have recently been advanced. In the context of array processing and direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation also, one bit quantizers have been studied in the past, although not as extensively. This paper shows that sparse arrays such as nested and coprime arrays are more robust to the deleterious effects of one-bit quantization, compared to uniform linear arrays (ULAs); in fact, sparse arrays with one-bit quantizers are often found to be as good as ULAs with unquantized data. Nested and coprime arrays without quanitzers are known to be able to resolve more DOAs than the number of sensors, when sources are uncorrelated. It will be demonstrated that this continues to be true even with one-bit quantization.

A survey of machine learning techniques for signal source localization and emitter tracking
Compressive TDOA estimation method based on amplitude phase clustering in time-frequency domain
data.abstractNote: In the field of signal processing, modulation signals, including phase shift keying (PSK) and quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM), can significantly enhance the signal‐to‐noise ratio (SNR) through aliasing transmission following clustering and sorting. This article presents two novel approaches to compressed time difference of arrival (TDOA) estimation, leveraging amplitude‐phase clustering signals. A carefully designed compression matrix is constructed based on the unique amplitude and phase characteristics of the signals. The study then analyzes the Cramér–Rao lower bound (CRLB) under full‐sampling conditions. Finally, TDOA estimation is performed using the approximate maximum likelihood (AML) method. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed compressed sampling TDOA estimation methods, based on amplitude‐phase clustering, achieve accuracy within an order of magnitude of full‐sampling performance. Additionally, this article explores the application of OFDM‐QAM signals, which exhibit amplitude‐phase convergence in the frequency domain, for time difference estimation in compressed sampling. A novel frequency‐domain aliasing time difference estimation algorithm based on amplitude‐phase convergence is proposed. Experimental results indicate that under high SNR conditions, the algorithm incurs only a minor SNR degradation of ~4 dB compared to time difference estimation in uncompressed transmission.

data.title: Performance assessment of one-bit compressed sensing techniques targeting IoT applications: a comparative study
data.abstractNote: One-bit Compressed Sensing (CS) is a novel approach in signal processing that focuses on the recovery of sparse signals from highly quantized measurements, specifically retaining only the sign information of the measurements. This extreme quantization reduces the data storage and transmission requirements, making it particularly suitable for resource constrained environments. Despite the loss of amplitude information, one-bit compressed sensing leverages advanced algorithms and theoretical frameworks to achieve accurate signal reconstruction. This technique has shown potential in various applications, including low-power sensor networks and medical imaging, where efficient data acquisition is crucial. This work provides a comparative study over various one-bit CS recovery techniques proposed in the literature with respect to measurement matrix structure, noise resilience, convexity, and side information requirement in terms of either noise or sparsity information. We conducted a comprehensive comparison of multiple algorithms on a certain setup, evaluating their performance in terms of Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), Hamming Distance (HD), and Hamming Error (HE) to assess their effectiveness in signal recovery. We extend our validation process for the recovery techniques through an adaptive setup focused on image compression and reconstruction using one-bit compressed sensing, emphasizing their suitability for hardware implementation in resource-constrained IoT hardware applications. Results provide guidance over appropriate algorithm selection for different IoT use cases. Evaluation process is performed with respect to reconstruction accuracy, reconstruction latency, and storage resources. In noiseless setup, the one-bit LP algorithm supersedes in terms of reconstruction accuracy utilizing small storage resources with latency overhead, meanwhile the Epin algorithm represents a better option in terms of reconstruction latency sacrificing the storage utilization to reach the same accuracy. However, at high noise margin the Passive algorithm has the best reconstruction accuracy compared to other algorithms.
data.shortTitle: Performance assessment of one-bit compressed sensing techniques targeting IoT applications

data.title: Positioning of UAVs in urban environments using fusion of TDOA and AOA data based on extended kalman filter
data.abstractNote: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have been extensively deployed across a range of applications thank to their flexibility and low cost. While this expansion has significantly improved their operational efficiency and service capacity, it has also posed challenges for UAV supervision and management systems. To address these issues, this paper proposes a three-dimensional (3D) localization method that integrates time difference of arrival (TDOA) and angle of arrival (AOA) measurements based on the extended Kalman filter (EKF). Specifically, for AOA-based positioning, a uniform circular array (UCA) is employed to capture spatial signal characteristics, and the multiple-signal classification (MUSIC) algorithm is applied to precisely estimate the azimuth and elevation angles of incoming signals. In TDOA-based localization, a multipath signal separation and identification algorithm is implemented to enhance robustness against multipath propagation in complex environments. Subsequently, the TDOA and AOA measurements are fused using the EKF, where nonlinear measurement models are linearized via Jacobian matrices to improve computational efficiency and estimation accuracy. Finally, simulation results demonstrate that the proposed hybrid localization method outperforms existing positioning methods that rely solely on AOA or TDOA, achieving a positioning accuracy of approximately 5 m and an angular error within 3°, which is suitable for applications in multipath environments such as urban areas.

data.title: Sparse signal reconstruction from limited data using FOCUSS: a re-weighted minimum norm algorithm
data.abstractNote: We present a nonparametric algorithm for finding localized energy solutions from limited data. The problem we address is underdetermined, and no prior knowledge of the shape of the region on which the solution is nonzero is assumed. Termed the FOcal Underdetermined System Solver (FOCUSS), the algorithm has two integral parts: a low-resolution initial estimate of the real signal and the iteration process that refines the initial estimate to the final localized energy solution. The iterations are based on weighted norm minimization of the dependent variable with the weights being a function of the preceding iterative solutions. The algorithm is presented as a general estimation tool usable across different applications. A detailed analysis laying the theoretical foundation for the algorithm is given and includes proofs of global and local convergence and a derivation of the rate of convergence. A view of the algorithm as a novel optimization method which combines desirable characteristics of both classical optimization and learning-based algorithms is provided. Mathematical results on conditions for uniqueness of sparse solutions are also given. Applications of the algorithm are illustrated on problems in direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation and neuromagnetic imaging.
data.shortTitle: Sparse signal reconstruction from limited data using FOCUSS
data.extra: TLDR: A view of the algorithm as a novel optimization method which combines desirable characteristics of both classical optimization and learning-based algorithms is provided and Mathematical results on conditions for uniqueness of sparse solutions are also given.

data.title: Data compression using SVD and fisher information for radar emitter location
data.abstractNote: This paper presents a method that achieves large compression ratios for radar pulse trains exploited in time-difference-of-arrival/frequency-difference-of-arrival (TDOA/FDOA) emitter location; this method exploits pulse-to-pulse redundancy to get a compression ratio much higher than possible by using standard methods. We show how to use (i) the singular value decomposition (SVD) to exploit redundancy between radar pulses, and (ii) a Fisher information-based distortion criterion to enable elimination of pulses that are negligible to the FDOA estimation task. To use the SVD it is necessary to first gate the pulses, place them in a matrix and then align the pulses to get a matrix that is close to rank one. Finally, we employ reasonable coding schemes for the information to be sent and assess the achievable compression level. With such SVD-based coding the compression ratio depends on the number of pulses intercepted and the number of samples taken per pulse; depending on the scenario the compression ratio can range from about 4 up to 100 or more. Fisher information-based removal of pulses is shown to improve the compression ratio beyond what is achievable using only the SVD approach while having negligible impact on the FDOA accuracy; it does, however, degrade the TDOA accuracy. However, we demonstrate that the SVD method includes an inherent de-noising effect (common in SVD-based signal processing) that provides an improvement in TDOA accuracy over the case of no compression processing; thus, the overall impact on TDOA/FDOA accuracy can be negligible while providing significant compression ratios for typical radar signals.
data.extra: TLDR: It is demonstrated that the SVD method includes an inherent de-noising effect (common in SVD-based signal processing) that provides an improvement in TDOA accuracy over the case of no compression processing; thus, the overall impact on TDOA/FDOA accuracy can be negligible while providing significant compression ratios for typical radar signals.

data.title: Non-MSE wavelet-based data compression for emitter location
data.abstractNote: The location of an emitter is estimated by intercepting its signal and sharing the data among several platforms to measure the time-difference-of-arrival (TDOA) and the frequency-difference-of-arrival (FDOA). Doing this in a timely fashion requires effective data compression. A common compression approach is to use a rate-distortion criterion where distortion is taken to be the mean-square error (MSE) between the original and compressed versions of the signal. However, in this paper we show that this MSE-only approach is inappropriate for TDOA/FDOA estimation and then define a more appropriate, non-MSE distortion measure. This measure is based on the fact that in addition to the dependence on MSE, the TDOA accuracy also depends inversely on the signal's RMS (or Gabor) bandwidth and the FDOA accuracy also depends inversely on the signal's RMS (or Gabor) duration. We discuss how the wavelet transform is a natural choice to exploit this non-MSE criterion. These ideas are shown to be natural generalizations of our previously presented results showing how to determine the correct balance between quantization and decimation. We develop a MSE-based wavelet method and then incorporate the non-MSE error criterion. Simulations show the wavelet method provides significant compression ratios with negligible accuracy reduction. We also make comparisons to methods that don't exploit time-frequency structure and see that the wavelet methods far out-perform them.

data.title: Decimation vs. quantization for data compression in TDOA systems
data.abstractNote: The location of an electromagnetic emitter is commonly estimated by intercepting its signal and then sharing the data among several platforms. Doing this in a timely fashion requires effective data compression. Previous data compression efforts have focused on minimizing the man- square error (MSE) due to compression. However, this criterion is likely to fall short because it fails to exploit how the signal's structure impacts the parameter estimates. Because TDOA accuracy depends on the signal's RMS bandwidth, compression techniques that can significantly reduce the amount of data while negligibly impacting the RMS bandwidth have great potential. We show that it is possible to exploit this idea by balancing the impacts of simple filtering/decimation and quantization and derive a criterion that determines an optimal balance between the amount of decimation and the level of quantization. This criterion is then used to show that by using a combination of decimation and quantization it is possible to meet requirements on data transfer time that can't be met through quantization alone. Furthermore, when quantization-alone approaches can meet the data transfer time requirement, we demonstrate that the decimation/quantization approach can lead to better TDOA accuracies. Rate-distortion curves are plotted to show the effectiveness of the approach.
data.extra: TLDR: It is shown that by using a combination of decimation and quantization it is possible to meet requirements on data transfer time that can be met through quantization alone, and it is demonstrated that the decimation/quantization approach can lead to better TDOA accuracies.

data.title: Mixed-precision quantization: make the best use of bits where they matter most
data.abstractNote: Mixed-precision quantization offers superior performance to fixed-precision quantization. It has been widely used in signal processing, communication systems, and machine learning. In mixed-precision quantization, bit allocation is essential. Hence, in this paper, we propose a new bit allocation framework for mixed-precision quantization from a search perspective. First, we formulate a general bit allocation problem for mixed-precision quantization. Then we introduce the penalized particle swarm optimization (PPSO) algorithm to address the integer consumption constraint. To improve efficiency and avoid iterations on infeasible solutions within the PPSO algorithm, a greedy criterion particle swarm optimization (GC-PSO) algorithm is proposed. The corresponding convergence analysis is derived based on dynamical system theory. Furthermore, we apply the above framework to some specific classic fields, i.e., finite impulse response (FIR) filters, receivers, and gradient descent. Numerical examples in each application underscore the superiority of the proposed framework to the existing algorithms.

Data compression trade-offs for multiple inferences in sensor networks
data.abstractNote: Sensor networks collect data upon which multiple inferences (estimations and decisions) will be based. The optimizing compression with respect to one inference may lead to suboptimal compression with respect to the others. Furthermore, not all of these inferences have the same level of importance to the end users of the network’s data. To address this, a framework is developed that uses specific distortion measures to assess the impact of compression on the multiple inferences: Fisher information is used to assess the impact on estimation accuracy while Chernoff and Kullback-Liebler distances are used to assess the impact on decision accuracy. This framework is applied to two examples: (i) multiple estimations and (ii) single estimation and a binary decision. Simulation results are provided that show that there is indeed a trade-off between these multiple inferences and that with proper a priori information the proposed data compression framework can enact trade-offs between them.

data.title: Multi-bit quantizer design for distributed parameter estimation
data.abstractNote: We consider sensors deployed in diverse locations measuring a common parameter through noisy observations. These observations are quantized to be sent to a fusion center doing the estimation of the common parameter. We design these quantizers to minimize the worst-case mean square error for common parameter estimation. Relying on an asymptotic regime in terms of sensors’ number and on random multi-bit quantizer per sensor, we provide a relevant continuous distribution for the thresholds of these quantizers via signomial programming. Through numerical simulations, we show that the proposed quantizers outperform the uniformly-distributed one and some deterministic ones even when the number of sensors is limited.

data.title: Extended ziv-zakai lower bound for vector parameter estimation
data.abstractNote: The Bayesian Ziv-Zakai bound on the mean square error (MSE) in estimating a uniformly distributed continuous random variable is extended for arbitrarily distributed continuous random vectors and for distortion functions other than MSE. The extended bound is evaluated for some representative problems in time-delay and bearing estimation. The resulting bounds have simple closed-form expressions, and closely predict the simulated performance of the maximum-likelihood estimator in all regions of operation.

data.title: A method exploiting compressive sampling for localization of radio frequency emitters
data.abstractNote: This article presents a novel method for radio frequency (RF) emitter localization by using wideband spectrum sensors (WSSs) exploiting compressive sampling (CS). The method assumes that R receivers with known Cartesian coordinates in the plane are deployed in the area, where the transmitters are expected to be. By using a nonuniform sampling (NUS) scheme, each WSS allows one to relax the throughput requirements for the data acquisition and transmission tasks. The mathematical description followed by numerical analysis is presented. Then, hardware implementation for the receiver was realized, by using commercial off-the-shelf components. The obtained results from simulation tests are reported, and an experimental assessment of the proposed method is provided. The experimental results are compared with those obtained by applying the maximum likelihood (ML) algorithm on the samples acquired according to the Nyquist criteria. As a figure-of-merit, the compression ratio (CR) of the proposed NUS scheme was evaluated and it was experimentally obtained that even for CR = 64 the spectrum reconstruction is acceptable for being used in the ML algorithm.

data.title: Conical localization via modified polar representation: a unified framework for robust 3-D positioning with 1-D sensor arrays
data.abstractNote: This paper presents a unified framework for robust three-dimensional (3-D) source localization using a network of sensors equipped with one-dimensional (1-D) linear arrays. While such arrays offer practical advantages in terms of cost and size, existing localization methods suffer from a fundamental limitation: their performance degrades significantly as the source moves into the far-field, a common challenge known as the thresholding effect. To address this issue, we reformulate the localization problem in the modified polar representation (MPR) coordinate system, which parameterizes the source location using its azimuth, elevation, and inverse-range. We have developed a constrained weighted least squares (CWLS) estimator, which is subsequently transformed into a tight semidefinite programming (SDP) problem via semidefinite relaxation, enhanced with additional constraints to improve accuracy. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed estimator attains the Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) for both angle and inverse-range estimation in near-field scenarios. More importantly, it maintains this optimal performance in the far-field, substantially outperforming state-of-the-art methods, which exhibit significant error at large ranges. The proposed solution thus provides a reliable, unified localization system that is effective irrespective of the source range.

data.title: 基于分布式监测的辐射源定位技术研究
data.abstractNote:
随着天地一体化信息网络、物联网、移动互联网等领域的迅猛发展,“伪基站”和“黑广播”等各类违规违法用频日益猖獗,严重扰乱社会秩序。军事领域中复杂电磁环境下新型干扰、雷达等辐射源的出现对常规电子侦察带来了严峻挑战。面对频谱安全与电磁频谱战形势,迫切需要高效、精准辐射源定位方法,从而实现电磁频谱资源的高效管控。分布式监测可以实现多个节点的协同工作,能够提高检测概率、定位精度。本文将围绕基于分布式监测的辐射源定位技术研究,选题具有重要的应用价值。本文的主要工作总结如下:
1)针对到达时间差(Time Difference of Arrival,TDOA)定位中的传统时延估计算法精度受限的问题,基于稀疏表示的信号模型,提出了一种离网格下的稀疏恢复时延估计算法。该算法考虑离网格的情况,利用稀疏恢复的方法,对估计得到的时延进行补偿。仿真结果表明,所提算法时延估计效果优于传统的广义互相关算法和稀疏恢复方法。
2)针对两步定位需要估计中间参数、存在误差积累的问题,提出了一种分布式天线中的频域直接定位(Direct Position Determination,DPD)算法,首先对多个节点的接收数据进行频域变换,并对频域数据进行合成,构造与目标位置相关的代价函数;然后,对目标所在的空间区域进行网格化,并基于代价函数对该区域进行网格化搜索,最终得到目标位置。仿真结果表明该定位性能优于TDOA算法和最小二乘DPD直接定位算法。
3)针对分布式多阵列多维谱峰搜索直接定位高复杂度问题,提出了两种降维直接定位算法,分别是基于多阵列的降维Capon直接定位算法和基于多阵列的降维多重信号分类(Multiple Signal Classification,MUSIC)直接定位算法。这两种算法均基于降维思想,考虑存在衰减系数的情况下,避免了衰减系数的估计,实现了多信源的位置估计。仿真结果表明,所提的两种降维算法,性能优于传统的到达角(Angle of Arrival,AOA)两步定位算法,在保证定位性能的同时,大大降低计算复杂度。
4)构建了分布式天线辐射源定位系统,对实测数据采集与处理。介绍了所使用的各种实验设备,并设计了数据发射与接收的实验方案,利用多种信号发射设备模拟未知辐射源在学校操场发射信号,利用监测节点接收数据。利用所提的分布式直接定位算法对数据进行处理。主要针对两大类数据进行了验证,第一类非同频干扰下的静止信源数据,第二类是同频干扰下的静止信源数据。最后的实测数据结果表明,所提的分布式天线中的频域直接定位算法能有效定位出目标的位置。

data.title: 基于TDOA和AOA的无线定位算法研究
data.abstractNote: 无线定位已经成为现代各科技领域中的一项不可或缺的技术。如何便捷地实现定位,获取高精度的目标位置信息,一直是无线定位技术中的关键问题。无线定位技术通过已知位置的基站及其对应的信号特征测量值来确定目标位置。在无线信道传播环境中,由于受噪声、非视距传播、多径效应等不利因素影响,信号特征测量值往往会产生误差,进而导致定位结果产生偏差。因此,本文主要研究如何减小这些不利因素的影响并获得高精度的定位算法。本文以无线定位算法为研究课题,重点研究了到达时间差(Time Difference of Arrival,TDOA)和到达角度(Angle of Arrival,AOA)两种定位技术下的定位算法,其主要研究内容分为以下三部分:1.在掌握无线定位基础理论及定位原理的前提下,给出了TDOA定位技术和AOA定位技术的数学模型。在此基础上,介绍了基本的定位方法并对其中的经典算法进行分析。此外,分析了实际应用中定位估计的误差来源并给出了定位算法性能的评价标准。2.针对视距传播环境,提出了一种闭式解和迭代相结合的定位方法和方差加权定位算法。闭式解相对较稳健,不会发散,迭代解在几何精度因子好的情况下精度很高,但是在几何精度因子差的情况下容易发散。本文提出的闭式解和迭代相结合的定位方法综合了两者的优点并规避其缺点,将一步加权最小二乘算法与泰勒递归算法相结合,在保证性能稳定性的情况下提高了算法的定位精度。现有的高精度定位算法因包含矩阵求逆运算而无法应用于低成本硬件设备。为此,本文提出了一种新的方差加权定位算法,在避免矩阵求逆的前提下给出了闭式解,为低成本硬件定位系统提供了一个高精度的位置估计方法。仿真结果表明该方法的定位精度接近克拉美罗下限。3.针对非视距传播环境,提出了两种新的学习型定位算法。现有的学习型定位算法都是通过直接建立非直达波信号特征值到位置的映射来估计目标位置的。而这种方式实际上是将问题复杂化了,因为直达波测量值到目标位置的非线性关系已经有精确模型,没必要再利用样本信息进行学习。因此,本文将学习算法主要用在非直达波误差测量值的校正上,再采用加权最小二乘算法求解目标位置,提出了一种基于距离差校正的学习型定位算法,有效的提高了非视距环境下的定位性能。在非视距多径传播环境下,以往利用信道冲击响应的定位算法或是只利用了其中的部分信息,或是需要绝对时间的脉冲响应。而本文采用具有相对时间的信道脉冲响应,提出了一种基于相对冲击的学习型定位算法。该算法采用非参数核回归建立信号特征到位置的映射,通过充分利用完整信道信息来提高定位精度。本文采用Winprop电磁仿真软件,利用3D射线追踪进行信道建模,对算法的定位性能进行了仿真测试。仿真结果表明,相比仅利用TDOA测量值的学习型定位方法,本文提出的基于相对冲击的定位方法能够获得更高的定位精度。

data.title: 基于波束赋形的TDOA和AOA定位技术研究
data.abstractNote: 自20世纪90年代美国联邦通信委员会颁布E-911定位需求规范以来,定位技术研究越来越受到了重视。从第一代到第五代移动通信网络,每一代的移动通信网络对定位技术都有研究。本文针对无线定位中基于TDOA和AOA的三维定位技术进行研究,主要工作如下:首先,针对TDOA估计问题,研究基于信道冲激响应的时延估计方法。提出一种基于改进的子空间追踪算法进行信道估计,并对直达径进行判断,然后估计直达径对应的时延作为到达时间估计。由于子空间追踪算法对输入有一定的要求,需要准确的稀疏度先验信息,稀疏度等于多径数。然而,源信号在实际环境中传输时的多径数无法确定,因此稀疏度无法准确确定。提出的基于改进的子空间追踪算法,可以解决稀疏度无法准确确定的问题,进而有效地估计信道。利用无线信道的稀疏特性,通过改进的子空间追踪算法估计得到的信道冲激响应,有利于提高TOA估计精度。其次,针对仰角AOA估计,分析现有的一维AOA估计算法,在MUSIC算法基础上,提出一种基于波束空间的MUSIC改进算法,估计服务基站和UE之间的仰角AOA。针对多径信号存在相干时,接收信号的自相关矩阵按特征向量展开,由于信号子空间的秩小于实际的信源数而导致估计结果误差较大的问题,研究将接收信号的自相关矩阵转化成Toeplitz矩阵解决相干性问题,并把阵元域信号通过波束赋形转换至波束域,实现降维以降低计算复杂度。通过波束赋形机制可以精确的估计仰角AOA。最后,利用信道估计到的CIR中的角度信息,对搜索区域做进一步约束,以得到直达径的AOA估计。最后,针对三维定位问题,提出一种基于TDOA和仰角AOA的三维定位方法,采用三个基站参与定位。在传统的三基站二维OTDOA定位的基础上,增加服务基站与UE之间的仰角AOA估计信息。利用AOA估计值和UE未知的x和y坐标表示高度z坐标,先利用Fang和Taylor联合定位算法解算UE的x和y坐标,再估计z坐标,最终得到UE的估计位置。

data.title: 基于无线传感器网络的目标定位与跟踪技术研究
data.abstractNote: 无线传感器网络技术是一门新兴的信息采集和处理技术,它是伴随着无线通信技术、传感器技术、分布式信息处理技术以及嵌入式技术的飞速发展而产生的。当今,在军事、工业以及社会生产中均用到无线传感器网络技术,而在这些应用中基于位置的服务是所有应用的基础。因此,无线定位跟踪技术是无线传感器网络应用中的关键技术之一,具有非常重要的研究意义和应用价值。本文在现有无线定位跟踪算法的基础上,以提高定位精度、降低计算复杂度以及减少能耗为目的对无线定位跟踪算法进行优化改进及设计。主要研究内容和研究成果如下:1、现有的任何一种定位算法均不能适应所有的定位场景,尤其是在一些特定场景下具有局限性,因此需对算法进行优化改进。(1)针对观测站点呈均匀圆阵列分布且目标靠近阵列中心时,出现对奇异矩阵求逆导致传统定位算法定位误差变大的问题,提出了基于混合测量模型(TDOA/TOA)的分离变量约束最小二乘算法。该算法避免了对奇异矩阵求逆,提高了定位精度,另外算法中数据处理技术也可扩展到其他定位模型中;(2)针对定位多个动态目标时传统算法精度不高,运算量较大的问题,提出了修正约束总体最小二乘算法。该算法全面考虑约束条件,引入拉格朗日乘子技术和拟牛顿的BFGS迭代公式,避免了计算Hessian矩阵,缩减了计算量,提高了定位精度;(3)针对目标靠近参考节点或任何一个坐标轴导致传统定位算法定位误差急剧增大的问题,提出了优化两步最小二乘算法。该算法通过再次选择参考站点和旋转坐标系统,避免了传统算法中的致命缺陷,以增加微小计算量的代价提高了算法的定位性能。2、针对非视距传播导致传统算法定位误差较大的问题,提出了鉴别非视距传播和减弱传播误差的优化定位算法。该算法通过Bayes序贯决策辨别出非视距传播,提出可修正的卡尔曼滤波算法,即自适应调整测量误差的方差和协方差矩阵,平滑测量数据从而减弱非视距传播带来的定位误差,最后采用残差加权算法估算出目标位置。该算法能够有效减弱因非视距传播导致的定位误差,现场物理实验和仿真实验验证了该算法的可行性和有效性。3、针对异构网络下的目标定位,来自不同类型的观测站点的测量数据融合问题,提出了一致性正交容积卡尔曼滤波定位跟踪算法。该算法引入附加变量代表状态向量中的非线性项,提出自适应加权因子调整不同类型信号输入系统的比重,实现优质信号的最大化输入,为设计高精度的算法提供可靠保障。然后通过正交容积卡尔曼滤波更新状态向量、速度向量以及附加变量,实现对动态目标的跟踪。仿真结果表明,所提算法定位性能优越,具有较强的鲁棒性。4、针对现存的被动式目标定位算法需要采集大量数据而导致运算量较大与能耗较高的问题,提出了基于压缩感知的目标定位跟踪优化算法。该算法设计了满足约束等距性的感知矩阵,提出了稀疏度自适应正交匹配追踪算法估算目标的个数(稀疏度),能够精确地恢复出目标的位置向量,实现了对目标的定位与跟踪。现场和仿真实验结果表明,所提算法在保证定位精度的前提下有效地缩减了数据采集量。

data.title: 基于信道状态信息的高效率直接定位方法研究
data.abstractNote:
随着通信感知一体化(Integrated Sensing and Communications,ISAC)的大力发展,基于通信设备进行高精度定位对于健康监测、虚拟现实以及自动驾驶等先进应用的准确实现越来越重要。在通信设备进行定位的众多方式中,信道状态信息(Channel State Information,CSI)由于能够基于位置信息明确建模进而提供精细化的定位结果。因此,基于CSI的定位方法研究是通信感知一体化领域当前研究热点。
对于基于CSI的定位问题,由于传统的两步定位方法忽略了中间参数来自同一目标这一重要约束,直接定位(Direct Position Determination,DPD)技术在位置估计精确性上具有优势。然而,常规DPD方法的不足也十分明显。原因在于传统DPD方法往往通过网格搜索估计位置。一方面,通信系统的计算资源有限,无法满足密集格点的需求,量化误差不可避免。另一方面,对于多目标位置的最大似然(Maximum Likelihood,ML)估计,在大范围场景中进行穷举搜索的效率极低并且实际难以实现。
针对以上问题,本文从迭代求解和降低基于格点的运算两个角度研究了基于CSI的高计算效率DPD方法,按章节可归纳为单目标快速直接定位方法、高维未知变量存在时不依赖格点密度的直接定位方法以及基于降维数据的直接定位方法,主要工作包括:
1.针对常规单目标DPD搜索方法无法实时处理的问题,本文提出了一种基于快速傅里叶变换(Fast Fourier Transform,FFT)的快速单目标ML直接定位算法(Fast Single Source ML DPD Algorithm,FSML-DPD)。FSML-DPD的位置谱是通过对CSI的FFT输出进行组合解算获得,而不是以直接穷举搜索的方式生成。大量的冗余重复计算得以消除。因此,相对于常规单目标直接定位算法,所论述算法的计算复杂度大大降低,同时仍然能保持一致的定位精度。
2.为了在发射频率偏移存在的场景下,移动站仍然能对单个静止用户设备(User Equipment,UE)进行高效率DPD,本文利用期望-最大(Expectation Maximization,EM)技术将目标-接收站向量作为潜在变量,迭代估计目标位置。结合拉普拉斯近似和极坐标系统,所论述算法将常规DPD中的多维搜索转变为对多个一维极角的估计,降低了计算复杂度,同时位置更新具有闭式解。尽管仍然需要估计发射频率偏移,但估计过程可以同时用于检测是否陷入局部最优,并通过修正估计方式离开局部最大点,冗余参数的存在成为了增益。因此,尽管所提出的基于EM的改进DPD算法(Modified EM-based DPD algorithm,MEM-DPD)本质上是在迭代处理非凸代价函数,仍然能够基于任意起始点获得全局最优解。
3.对于多目标场景下的ML直接定位问题,常规的穷举搜索计算上是不切实际的。基于平克斯定理,DPD代价函数可以转化为期望计算函数,从而位置估计通过样本求解均值获得,而样本可以通过对原始DPD代价函数进行重要性采样(Importance Sampling,IS)为每个目标分别生成,因此基于IS的DPD算法(IS-based DPD Algorithm,IS-DPD)计算复杂度相比于穷举搜索显著降低,而且能够并行实现。然而,现有的IS-DPD使用的重要性函数只简单考虑所有目标源是完全独立的,没有考虑目标距离很近的情况下的强耦合关系。因此,本文论述了一种基于改进自适应重要性函数的DPD算法(Modified IS-based DPD Algorithm,MIS-DPD)。所论述算法根据目标距离对不同目标进行分类,对于近距离目标的重要性函数构建考虑了它们之间的耦合关系,从而MIS-DPD相比常规IS-DPD更加鲁棒和普适。
4.在通信资源极为有限的场景下,传送到中心处理站的CSI往往是经过数据降维的。为了对CSI进行波束域降维,只筛选包含直达径的最优波束CSI进行后续处理,因此本文介绍了一种基于首径时延最小的最优波束选择方法,相比于基于波束功率的方法更加鲁棒,尤其是在直达径弱的恶劣室内环境。在进行最优波束选取后考虑对CSI进行单比特量化继续降低数据维度,针对单比特CSI的ML直接定位问题,直接处理ML代价函数估计位置需要同时对衰减因子使用梯度方法迭代估计,然而梯度计算中存在复杂的积分和指数运算。因此,现有的单比特ML直接定位算法存在大量冗余的计算。本文论述了一种基于最大最小化(Majorization–Minimization,MM)策略的单比特DPD算法(MM-based One-Bit DPD Algorithm,MO-DPD),所论述算法迭代解决ML代价函数,在每次迭代中,冗余参数的估计存在闭式解,棘手的梯度计算得以避免,这使得MO-DPD相比当前的单比特ML直接定位算法计算复杂度大大降低,同时精度仍然能够保持。
本文从理论分析和实验验证两个角度展示了所提出算法的性能,也表明了基于CSI的DPD算法在保证较低计算复杂度的同时仍然满足高定位精度的可行性。

data.title: 基于TDOA/AOA的多站无源定位与跟踪算法研究
data.abstractNote: 现如今,电磁环境日益复杂,电子对抗技术不断的发展与成熟,如何在电子战中精确、及时、隐蔽的对敌方目标辐射源进行定位与跟踪成为了抢得战场先机的关键。因此,无源定位跟踪技术成为了电子战中十分重要的技术手段。本文以传统的测向交叉定位与时差定位体制为基础,介绍了时差-交叉联合定位体制与算法,并针对实际应用中存在的一些问题,展开了相关研究。首先,本文介绍了基本的时差定位与测向交叉定位模型,并出于将两种算法的优势进行互补的目的,介绍了时差-交叉联合定位模型,推导了联合定位模型的几何精度因子公式,并介绍了两种针对该联合模型的闭式解算算法。其次,针对传统的伪线性闭式解算算法在误差增大时容易出现门限效应,导致定位精度急剧恶化的缺点,提出一种基于樽海鞘群算法的定位技术,该算法模拟了樽海鞘群体捕食的过程,智能的对观测空间进行搜索,基于最大似然原则给出估计解,有效的改善了门限效应。另外,根据多站无源定位模型的特征,对原始的樽海鞘群算法进行了改进,实验结果表明,改进后的算法在保持群体收敛能力的同时,极大程度上增强了前期随机搜索的能力,进一步提高了定位精度。另外,本文针对多站定位体制在实际应用中容易出现的模糊定位问题进行了研究。对于测向交叉定位的模糊问题,本文对宽带噪声调频信号的模糊点排除问题进行了研究,在多个信号混杂无法辨别到达时间的情况下,利用宽带噪声调频信号的特征,给出了一种通过信号的自相关特征求取时差信息的方法,可以有效解决此类情况下的模糊点排除问题。而对于时差定位中的定位模糊问题,本文针对由于高重频信号配对错误导致产生多组模糊时差的情况进行了分析,利用模糊点与真实点运动规律不同的特点,提出一种方法,本方法对所有估计点进行跟踪,估计每个点的速度信息,通过对估计点的速度进行判决而对模糊点进行排除。最后,本文针对一种非共视条件下的目标跟踪问题进行了研究。由于观测空间中存在障碍物遮挡,或目标与观测站之间相对运动等多种原因导致目标在某些时刻无法被所有观测站同时观测,此时由于信息的缺失,传统意义上无法对目标轨迹进行正确跟踪。本文对这种环境下观测信息的变化进行了详细分析,并针对这种条件下的跟踪问题,提出了利用过程噪声方差矩阵来平衡对预测值的信任度,从而可以在弱观测区间得到相对稳定的估计结果,通过仿真结果与理论分析,证明了该方法可以有效提高跟踪效果,使跟踪结果更稳定。

data.title: 基于离散萤火虫压缩感知重构的无线传感器网络多目标定位
data.abstractNote: 研究了压缩感知(CS)理论在无线传感器网络(WSNs)多目标定位中的应用。提出一种基于离散萤火虫算法的压缩感知重构方法,并设计了具体算法实现流程,该算法摆脱了传统压缩感知重构算法对稀疏度K的依赖且能够准确地重构出原始信号。基于此,将新的压缩感知重构算法应用于WSNs目标定位,建立了WSNs系统模型,构造了合理的测量矩阵和稀疏矩阵,并分析了测量矩阵与重构结果之间的关系,最终实现了WSNs多目标定位。仿真结果表明该方法在稀疏信号重构性能及多目标定位精度方面具有较好效果,定位精度优于贪婪匹配跟踪(GMP)算法、正交匹配追踪(OMP)算法和最大似然估计(MLE)算法,且用于WSNs定位的传感器节点数目减少了20%,抗噪性达到了20dB。

data.title: 分布式感知的时差估计及定位技术研究
data.abstractNote:
无源定位在雷达、声呐以及无线通信等领域都有着广泛的应用,时差(Time Difference of Arrival,TDOA)定位技术是一种重要的无源定位技术,因其适用场景多、定位精度高而受到众多关注和研究。在TDOA定位中,时差估计的精度直接影响到最终目标定位性能,因此本文重点研究了时差估计方法的改进。与此同时,随着集成电路运算能力的增强,直接定位(Direct Position Determination,DPD)技术逐渐成为无源定位重要发展方向,DPD方法直接利用接收信号中所蕴含的位置信息估计出目标位置,避免了两步定位法中因中间参数估计与定位解算两个过程独立执行所导致的定位性能损失。本文进一步研究并提出了新的DPD方法,获得了定位性能提升。主要研究工作和贡献可以总结如下。
1)针对互相关类的时差参数估计方法精度受限于采样间隔的问题,提出了一种基于泰勒补偿的时差估计方法,首先基于广义互相关方法(Generalized Cross Correlation,GCC)估计出各节点时差作为初始值,该初始值为采样间隔的整数倍,误差较大,然后利用信号模型结合泰勒级数展开对各节点初始值一一补偿,通过最小二乘(Least Square,LS)即可获得补偿值,计算复杂度较低。同时,通过分析互谱域中的时差信息,在多重信号分类(Multiple Signal Classification,MUSIC)方法基础之上提出了一种基于正交性补偿的时差估计方法,该方法利用归一化互谱构建信号模型,再通过泰勒级数展开获得与真实值之间的偏移量,并将其补偿到初始估计值中。该方法可获得高分辨率时差估计结果,与MUSIC时差估计方法相比提高了估计精度,而且无需估计未知信号的功率谱,降低了计算复杂度。
2)为进一步提升时差估计性能,综合利用所有节点数据,提出了一种基于平行因子(Parallel Factor,PARAFAC)分析的时差估计方法。该方法通过对接收信号进行离散傅里叶变换(Discrete Fourier Transform,DFT),在频域内抽取信号有效带宽频点,利用多节点时差信息建立PARAFAC信号模型,经三线性分解获得时差矩阵,可同时估计出各节点与参考节点间的TDOA。在此基础上,进一步提出了一种在互谱域中基于平行因子的时差估计方法。该方法首先计算参考节点与其他节点之间接收信号的互功率谱密度函数,提取并融合信号有效带宽内的互谱域数据,构建平行因子模型,由三线性拟合实现对时差矩阵的精确估计,利用已知的逆离散傅里叶变换(Inverse DFT,IDFT)矩阵和归一化方法解决模糊问题,从时差矩阵中提取相位,由此可同时获得多节点的TDOA估计,并降低噪声影响,在低信噪比下也具有很好的估计精度。
3)将平行因子概念拓展至直接定位模型中,提出了一种基于平行因子的DPD方法。该方法经构建平行因子模型并由三线性分解估计出时差矩阵之后,根据时差矩阵和未知辐射源到各节点时差信息的关联性,建立了与源位置直接相关的代价函数,将区域中的网格位置代入之后搜索极大值实现目标位置定位。为了进一步提升定位性能,提出了一种在互谱域中基于平行因子的DPD方法。该方法利用各节点与参考节点的互谱函数构建平行因子模型,通过三线性拟合获得时差矩阵,基于LS算法建立与源位置直接相关的关系式,经过对时差矩阵和未知辐射源到各节点时差信息的关系进行分析和转化之后,累加多个频点的数据构建最终的DPD代价函数,通过对监测区域的网格化搜索实现源定位。与基于最小二乘的DPD方法相比,所提DPD方法具有更好的定位性能和更低的计算复杂度。
4)基于分布式感知实测系统,进行了辐射源定位的实际测试,研究和分析了所提算法在实测场景中的定位效果。利用小型频谱设备构建了分布式无源感知系统,采集实际环境中的辐射源数据并对其进行处理来验证算法性能。基于系统设备设计了实验方案,利用矢量信号发生器、USRP、无人机等设备发射多种信号模拟未知辐射源。通过监测节点同步收集未知信号并将其发送至数据处理中心,结合所提出的各种定位算法对接收数据进行处理。实测数据处理结果表明,所提算法均能有效定位出目标的位置,在所采用的实测系统和环境内,DPD方法定位精度在10m以内,TDOA方法定位精度在20m以内。

data.title: 利用校正目标的单站AOA-TDOA无源相干定位算法
data.abstractNote: 针对外辐射源位置误差导致基于角度(AOA)-时差(TDOA)的单站无源相干定位系统定位精度下降的问题，提出一种利用校正目标的外辐射源位置误差校正和目标定位算法。首先，将位置已知的校正目标对应的AOA和TDOA测量方程转化为关于外辐射源位置误差的线性方程，并利用贝叶斯-高斯-马尔可夫定理得到外辐射源位置误差的线性最小均方误差解，从而校正外辐射源的位置误差；其次，利用校正后的外辐射源位置误差及其统计特性，推导目标位置的加权最小二乘代数解；最后，推导了校正目标下的单站AOA-TDOA无源相干定位克拉美罗界(CRLB)和算法的理论误差，并证明了二者的等价性。仿真结果表明算法可以从CRLB的层面上降低外辐射源位置误差对目标定位精度的影响。

data.title: 基于修正极坐标的异步阵列网络直接定位算法研究
data.abstractNote: 基于异步无线传感器阵列网络(WSAN)的直接定位技术利用不完全同步的网络节点测量的辐射源信号实现目标定位。由于其抗干扰能力强、同步要求低、定位精度高等优点,被广泛用于军事侦察、智慧交通等领域。然而,传统异步WSAN直接定位技术通常采用笛卡尔坐标系,而该坐标系下的定位模型存在模型失配问题,尤其在远场条件下,定位性能会显著下降,导致距离阈值效应的产生。针对上述问题,本文基于修正极坐标(MPR)对异步WSAN的直接定位技术进行研究。考虑到阵列节点的相干性及时钟偏差的影响,本文提出了三种基于MPR的定位算法:到达角(AOA)直接定位方法、同步AOA-到达时差(TDOA)直接定位方法以及异步AOA-TDOA联合校准时钟的直接定位方法。此外,本文对这三种算法进行了深入的性能分析,以探讨其在不同应用场景下的定位精度和鲁棒性。具体的研究内容如下:(1)使用修正极坐标构建基于AOA、TDOA的异步WSAN直接定位模型。首先,在忽略阵列节点相干性的情况下,建立基于AOA的异步WSAN直接定位模型。随后,进一步考虑阵列网络之间节点相干性,构建基于AOA-TDOA的同步WSAN直接定位模型。接着,在此基础上引入不同阵列间的时钟偏差,构建基于AOA-TDOA的异步WSAN直接定位模型。最后,通过性能下界推导对比了三种模型理论上的最优性能。(2)为分析时钟偏差与测量噪声对定位性能的敏感性,本文通过小误差分析(SEA),推导了时钟偏差对定位结果的理论偏差,以及观测噪声对定位结果的理论均方误差,并通过仿真将时钟偏差与观测噪声对定位结果的均方误差与性能下界进行比较,分析两者对定位性能的敏感性。(3)为解决传统基于WSAN的直接定位技术在笛卡尔坐标系下的模型失配问题,提出了一种基于修正极坐标的WSAN直接定位方法,包括基于AOA的WSAN直接定位方法和基于AOA-TDOA的WSAN直接定位方法,分别采用高斯牛顿和交替迭代优化进行求解。相比于传统基于笛卡尔坐标的直接定位方法,提升了算法的数值稳定性与定位精度。(4)进一步考虑异步网络的时钟偏差校准问题,提出了一种联合校准时钟偏差和辐射源定位算法,采用先估计时钟偏差,再进行目标定位的分步策略,避免了高维参数估计,极大降低了计算复杂度。此外利用SEA方法,分析了联合校准时钟偏差和辐射源定位的理论均方误差。最后,通过仿真实验验证所提算法的有效性。

data.title: Communication-constrained resource scheduling for multi-station cooperative time-difference-of-arrival localization
data.abstractNote: Distributed electronic reconnaissance systems improve passive emitter localization by fusing pulse descriptor words (PDWs) collected from spatially separated stations. However, under limited backhaul resources, transmitting all available PDWs is often impractical. This paper investigates a task-oriented cooperative time-difference-of-arrival (TDOA) localization problem in which the master station, assisting stations, and the number of transmitted PDWs on each link must be jointly optimized. A Cramér–Rao lower bound (CRLB) model is first derived for coarse prior target positions by using a two-term TDOA measurement-error model, where the error consists of distance-dependent TDOA measurement error and constant TDOA measurement error. Based on this model, a mixed-integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) problem is formulated to minimize the total PDW transmission time while satisfying localization-accuracy, PDW transmission-time budget, station-selection, and PDW-availability constraints. To reduce the combinatorial search burden, a three-stage semidefinite-relaxation-based scheduling method is developed for master-station selection, assisting-station relaxation, and integer PDW recovery. Simulation results in a five-station scenario with 1000 Monte Carlo trials compare the proposed method with heuristic baselines, fixed PDW allocation, master-station enumeration, and a GA-based MINLP benchmark in terms of scheduling success rate, average PDW transmission time, and runtime.

data.title: Asymmetric time difference measurement technology for multi-satellite localization
data.abstractNote: This paper addresses the critical challenge of high-precision time difference of arrival (TDOA) estimation in multi-satellite localization systems operating under asymmetric reception conditions, where auxiliary satellites receive signals at extremely low signal-to-noise ratios (SNR). To overcome this limitation, we propose a novel and integrated TDOA measurement framework. The core of our approach involves three synergistic components: a geometric pre-processing method to rigorously define a robust search window for the TDOA, leveraging coarse target information from the high-SNR main satellite; an overlap-add based segmented circular convolution algorithm that enables computationally efficient cross-correlation between the main and auxiliary satellite signals; and a Cumulative Peak Detection Algorithm based on Dual Haar Wavelet Transform (CPDA-DHWT) designed to extract the true delay peak reliably despite severe distortion induced by low SNR. Comprehensive simulations and hardware experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly outperforms conventional methods in terms of both estimation accuracy and computational efficiency under challenging low-SNR scenarios. Furthermore, its inherently modular architecture provides a scalable foundation for one-main-multi-auxiliary multi-satellite collaborative localization networks.

data.title: Application-specific compression for time delay estimation in sensor networks
data.abstractNote: Sensor networks have emerged as a fundamentally new tool for monitoring inaccessible environments. They are distinguished from traditional sensors by strict limitations on system bandwidth and sensor energy resources. These constraints motivate the use of data compression at each sensor. Location finding is an important application of sensor networks, and estimation of the time delay between data from different sensors is a key step in localization. In this work, new quantizer designs specific to the time-delay estimation problem in sensor networks are presented. The goal for these new application-specific encoders is to achieve the best time delay estimate at a given bandwidth budget or latency bound, or minimize the rate required to reach an estimate with desired accuracy.

data.title: Dynamic spectrum cartography: reconstructing spatial-spectral-temporal radio frequency map via tensor completion
data.abstractNote: Spectrum cartography (SC) aims to construct a global radio-frequency (RF) map across multiple domains, e.g., space, frequency and time, from sparse sensor samples. Recent state-of-the-art SC methods have successfully established the recoverability of 3-D spatial-spectral RF maps using identifiable models, such as non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) and block-term tensor decomposition (BTD). However, these models do not account for possible time dynamics in RF environment. This work takes a step forward and focuses on a 4-D spatial-spectral-temporal SC task under time-varying scenarios. From a data recovery viewpoint, the task is highly ill-posed since the degree of freedom (DoF) in a 4-D map is extremely high. To address this issue, a two-stage methodology is put forth: for stage one, sensor measurements are unraveled into incomplete RF map w.r.t each emitter; for stage two, individual RF maps are completed in parallel and then synthesize the 4-D map. In this way, DoF in the recovery process is significantly reduced. Two different algorithms are designed, including a basic batch-based one and a full-fledged streaming one enabling on-line SC. From the theory side, recoverability of the proposed approaches is characterized by certain sampling patterns or complexity. Experiments using synthetic, ray-tracing, and real-world data are employed to showcase the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

data.title: Robust TOA-based localization under NLOS conditions using structured total least squares
data.abstractNote: Time-of-arrival (TOA)-based localization suffers significant performance degradation in non-line-of-sight (NLOS) environments due to biased and highly uncertain ranging results. Existing methods often ignore the geometric structure of ranging errors and rely on preset uncertainty bounds, leading to limited robustness under severe NLOS conditions. Given these limitations, we propose a geometrically informed unified structured total least squares-robust least squares (TLS-RLS) framework for TOA localization in NLOS environments. Unlike existing methods, the proposed approach exploits the intrinsic geometric consistency of the errors. In the first stage, a geometry-constrained masked TLS correction is constructed to provide a structure-consistent nominal model, a geometry-constrained perturbation family, and an induced data-adaptive uncertainty radius from the measurement data. These outputs are then inherited by the second-stage RLS minimax formulation to define its structured uncertainty set, enabling worst-case optimization over admissible perturbations rather than arbitrary full-matrix disturbances. On this basis, the resulting minimax problem is transformed through convex reformulations into a standard semidefinite programming (SDP) problem that can be solved efficiently. Simulations in various NLOS scenarios and real-world experiments in laboratory and industrial environments demonstrate that this method offers higher accuracy and stability compared to existing methods.

data.title: Maximum likelihood TDOA estimation from compressed sensing samples without reconstruction
data.abstractNote: One application for time-difference-of-arrival (TDOA) estimation is in emitter localization. A signal from an emitter reaching a group of sensors, each in a separate location, will have different arrival times. Finding the TDOAs between the output of pairs of sensors will provide the necessary measurements for the hyperbolic localization of the emitter. When the sensors acquire the signal by compressed sensing (CS), their outputs are reduced dimension linear transformation of the time samples of the signal. This shuffling of the time samples breaks up their time relation. Thus, a cross correlation of the CS output of two sensors cannot determine the TDOA. To apply cross correlation, it is necessary to reconstruct the time samples. This letter proposes an alternative that uses only the coefficients of the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) of the CS samples. It begins with the derivation of the maximum likelihood (ML) equation and the ML estimator. This estimator requires known values of signal and noise powers. Substituting these values by their estimates lead to the approximate ML estimator. The phase of the product of two DFT coefficients from each sensor is proportional to the unknown TDOA. Hence, these coefficients can provide an estimation of the TDOA. Simulation results show that although ML is the best, as expected, all these estimators have very close performance.

data.title: Compressive TDOA estimation: cramér–rao bound and incoherent processing
data.abstractNote: Estimation of time-difference-of-arrival (TDOA) between a signal and its time-shifted version has many applications, mostly in localization. Because compressive sensing (CS) can reduce the sampling rate and data volume, TDOA estimation from CS samples (CS-TDOA) has become a subject of interest. Generally, CS-TDOA has lower estimation accuracy, and the Cramér-Rao bound (CRB) can quantify this degradation. The first part of this correspondence derives the CRB for CS-TDOA estimation, and the second part proposes an incoherent processing scheme for CS-TDOA estimation using partial Fourier coefficients. This results in the reduction of the number of sampling channels needed to acquire those coefficients. Simulation results are given to corroborate the theoretical development.

data.title: Source localization using TDOA based on improved competition of tribes and cooperation of members algorithm
data.abstractNote: Passive localization estimates a target’s position by receiving signals emitted or reflected by the target, such as electromagnetic or acoustic waves. Time Difference of Arrival (TDOA) localization determines the source position by measuring the arrival time differences of signals at spatially separated receivers. However, the strong nonlinearity and non-convexity of TDOA localization equations make traditional analytical methods highly sensitive to noise, often resulting in large positioning errors under low signal-to-noise ratio conditions.To address these challenges, this paper applies the Competition of Tribes and Cooperation of Members (CTCM) metaheuristic algorithm to the TDOA localization problem and further proposes several targeted improvements. First, a tribe selection mechanism is introduced during the cooperation phase to enhance local search capability and accelerate intra-tribe convergence. Second, the original conflict mechanism in the competition phase is replaced with a resource plundering and annexation strategy, which improves global exploration in the early stage while strengthening convergence in the later stage. Finally, a tribe reconstruction mechanism is designed to optimize population diversity and overall solution quality.Monte Carlo simulation results demonstrate that the improved CTCM algorithm achieves superior convergence performance and higher localization accuracy compared with existing methods.

data.title: TDOA estimation with compressive sensing measurements and hadamard matrix
data.abstractNote: This paper employs a special property of the Hadamard matrix to develop a novel compressive sensing (CS) based framework that eliminates the complex reconstruction step required by standard CS methods. In particular, time-difference-of-arrivals (TDOAs) of a signal at different receivers involved in positioning of unknown sources are directly estimated from CS measurements, without any attempt to reconstruct the full signals. Although this approach is designed for TDOA estimation, it is also capable of accommodating other CS applications.

data.title: 基于压缩传输的无源定位技术
data.abstractNote:
无源定位方法通过接收外部信号进行探测和定位,而无需自己发射信号。其中,时差定位法通过计算接收信号的到达时间差来对目标位置进行判断,与此不同的是,直接定位技术直接从信号中提取位置信息,无需估计中间变量,而是构建信号与源位置之间的直接映射。
为了解决传统到达时间差估计在带宽效率上的局限,本文采用了压缩传输策略,即接收站直接对目标辐射源信号进行压缩采样,之后将压缩信号传输至中心处理站进行TDOA估计,无需对压缩信号进行重构。压缩传输不仅减少了TDOA估计过程中的传输和计算负担,还保留了信号中的时差和多普勒频率信息,使其适用于直接定位方法。主要研究内容有以下几个方面:
1.研究了无源定位中传统的基于时差估计的两步定位技术,以及基于时差和多普勒频率信息的直接定位技术,为后续基于压缩传输的定位技术提供理论基础,并将经过压缩传输的定位结果与传统未压缩的定位结果进行对比,展现出不同压缩率下压缩传输定位的精度损耗。
2.研究了一种新型时差估计定位算法,该算法利用傅里叶矩阵、循环测量矩阵和哈达玛测量矩阵使两路压缩信号保留原信号时移关系的特性,能够快速对压缩信号进行互相关分析,来对信号到达时差进行估计,无需恢复原始信号,再将基于压缩测量的时差估计与时差定位技术相结合。仿真实验进行了多种压缩比例和不同定位算法条件下的仿真测试,在信噪比较高且压缩比例大于1 4的情况下,基于压缩测量的时差定位精度损耗保持在20%以下。
3.提出了基于信号压缩传输的直接定位方法,由于哈达玛测量矩阵压缩时差估计在低信噪比下估计较为准确,于是选择哈达玛矩阵进行压缩采样,并直接在压缩测量域中估计源位置,不需要进行信号重构以及时差和多普勒频率参数的提取。本文证明信号经过哈达玛测量矩阵压缩后仍然能够保留时差和多普勒频率信息,从而在保留定位精度的同时降低传输量。

data.title: Sensing, compression, and recovery for WSNs: sparse signal modeling and monitoring framework
data.abstractNote: We address the problem of compressing large and distributed signals monitored by a Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) and recovering them through the collection of a small number of samples. We propose a sparsity model that allows the use of Compressive Sensing (CS) for the online recovery of large data sets in real WSN scenarios, exploiting Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to capture the spatial and temporal characteristics of real signals. Bayesian analysis is utilized to approximate the statistical distribution of the principal components and to show that the Laplacian distribution provides an accurate representation of the statistics of real data. This combined CS and PCA technique is subsequently integrated into a novel framework, namely, SCoRe1: Sensing, Compression and Recovery through ON-line Estimation for WSNs. SCoRe1 is able to effectively self-adapt to unpredictable changes in the signal statistics thanks to a feedback control loop that estimates, in real time, the signal reconstruction error. We also propose an extensive validation of the framework used in conjunction with CS as well as with standard interpolation techniques, testing its performance for real world signals. The results in this paper have the merit of shedding new light on the performance limits of CS when used as a recovery tool in WSNs.
data.shortTitle: Sensing, compression, and recovery for WSNs

data.title: Spectral compressive sensing
data.abstractNote: Compressive sensing (CS) is a new approach to simultaneous sensing and compression of sparse and compressible signals based on randomized dimensionality reduction. To recover a signal from its compressive measurements, standard CS algorithms seek the sparsest signal in some discrete basis or frame that agrees with the measurements. A great many applications feature smooth or modulated signals that are frequency-sparse and can be modeled as a superposition of a small number of sinusoids; for such signals, the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) basis is a natural choice for CS recovery. Unfortunately, such signals are only sparse in the DFT domain when the sinusoid frequencies live precisely at the centers of the DFT bins; when this is not the case, CS recovery performance degrades significantly. In this paper, we introduce the spectral CS (SCS) recovery framework for arbitrary frequency-sparse signals. The key ingredients are an over-sampled DFT frame and a restricted union-of-subspaces signal model that inhibits closely spaced sinusoids. We demonstrate that SCS significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art CS algorithms based on the DFT while providing provable bounds on the number of measurements required for stable recovery. We also leverage line spectral estimation methods (specifically Thomsonʼs multitaper method and MUSIC) to further improve the performance of SCS recovery.

data.title: 低数据传输量的直接定位方法研究
data.abstractNote:
分布式阵列在边界监控、目标探测和定位等军事领域发挥了巨大作用,同时在智能驾驶、无人机编队、交通监测和环境监测等民用领域中也得到了广泛应用。基于分布式阵列的信号检测、参数估计与目标定位通常是分步进行的,存在探测定位性能差、抗干扰和噪声能力弱等问题。近年来,直接定位方法基于各阵列节点接收信号一步完成信号检测与目标定位,能够实现更高的多目标分辨和定位精度。然而,直接定位方法需要分布式阵列节点之间的数据传输,受到传输带宽的限制。此外,信号采样通常是基于单节点的,未考虑分布式阵列中各节点采样之间的冗余性,导致量化精度要求高,增加了系统复杂度和硬件功耗。因此,急需开展节点低比特量化采样、节点间低数据传输量的直接定位方法研究。
本文的研究内容和主要贡献包括以下几个方面:
1.针对传统直接定位方法所需要的节点间数据传输量受传输带宽限制、计算复杂度高的问题,提出了一种基于Copula融合的快速(Fast Copula-based Fusion,F-CBF)直接定位方法。先通过单比特硬判决降低了各个节点的数据传输量,再利用F-CBF进行目标检测,并在快速低数据传输量的目标检测基础上,基于粒子群优化确定直接定位结果,在保持定位精度的同时,降低了算法的计算复杂度。
2.针对传统直接定位方法对节点量化精度要求高的问题,提出了基于单比特量化信号的直接定位方法。该方法考虑了分布式阵列中各节点采样之间的冗余性,通过设计单比特固定门限量化器使得所提算法的检测性能最优;从理论上分析了单比特量化信号与高精度量化信号的检测和定位性能,并给出了补偿单比特直接定位算法性能损失的方案。理论与仿真实验验证了所提算法极大降低了节点量化精度,相比经典的单比特两步定位方法性能更优,同时与现有最优的单比特直接定位算法的性能相当且计算复杂度更低。
3.针对固定零门限量化(Zero-Thresholding Quantization,ZQ)方案导致单比特直接定位算法性能损失的问题,提出了基于时变门限量化的改进单比特直接定位方法。该方法设计了两种时变量化方案:最优量化(Optimal Quantization,OQ)和随机量化(Random Quantization,RQ),并构建了基于时变门限量化的单比特直接定位方法,有效降低了涉及各节点接收信号复幅度联合搜索的计算复杂度,同时在检测与定位性能方面均优于ZQ方案。
4.针对单比特量化带来的直接定位算法性能损失问题,提出了基于组合比特量化架构设计的多目标直接定位方法。该方法通过组合比特量化方式保留了更多目标相关的信息,并给出了组合比特接收信号的克拉美罗下界(Cramér-Rao Lower Bound,CRLB),在最佳组合情况下,所提算法实现了与高精度量化信号相当的定位性能,且有效降低了数据传输量。此外,针对基于最大似然的单比特直接定位算法无法识别多个近目标的问题,提出了基于多目标的单比特超分辨直接定位算法,解决了多个近目标难以分离的问题且计算效率更高。
通过仿真实验验证了上述的理论分析以及所提算法的性能,为基于分布式阵列的直接定位技术在数据传输量与性能之间的合理权衡提供理论方法支撑。

data.title: On the suboptimality of rate–distortion-optimal compression: fundamental accuracy limits for distributed localization
data.abstractNote: We derive fundamental accuracy limits for distributed localization when a fusion center has access only to independently rate–distortion (RD)-optimally compressed versions of multi-sensor observations, under a line-of-sight propagation model with a Gaussian wideband waveform. Using the Gaussian RD test-channel model together with a Whittle spectral Fisher-information characterization, we obtain an explicit frequency-domain Cramér–Rao lower bound. A two-band, two-level specialization yields closed-form expressions and reveals a rate-induced regime change: RD-optimal compression under a squared-error distortion measure can eliminate localization-informative spectral content. A simple band-selective scheme can outperform RD compression by orders of magnitude at the same rate, motivating localization-aware compression for networked sensing and integrated sensing and communication systems.

data.title: Neighborhood selection-based distributed maximum correlation accumulation direct position determination
data.abstractNote: Existing distributed direct position determination algorithms with single-hop transmission face convergence issues under low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) environment. In addition, these algorithms employ the conventional neighborhood all-selection (AS) strategy, where each sensor communicates and shares information with all neighboring sensors. In large-scale sensor networks, each sensor may have a substantial number of neighbors. Receiving and processing data from the entire neighborhood leads to significant communication overhead, high computational load, and slow convergence speed. To address these issues, this article proposes a distributed direct position determination algorithm with single-hop transmission. A cost function for distributed localization is derived from the classical centralized direct position determination, leveraging the correlation of received signals between sensors. To maximize the cost function, each sensor iteratively updates its estimate based on the diffusion strategy and the gradient ascent method. Two neighborhood selection strategies are proposed to select neighbors for each sensor. Data are only received and processed from the selected neighbors, resulting in reduced communication and computation within the sensor network. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm maintains good convergence even under low SNR environment. Compared to the AS strategy, the proposed neighborhood selection strategies reduce communication overhead and computational burden of the sensor network, while enhancing the convergence speed of the algorithm.

data.title: Bandwidth-efficient TDOA estimation in generalized differential positioning with OFDM satellite signals of opportunity
data.abstractNote: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) modulation has been used in Starlink, OneWeb and considered for using in many emerging low earth orbit (LEO) satellite communication systems. The explosive growth of OFDM satellite signals provides a plethora of satellite signals of opportunity (SOOPs) for intelligent vehicle systems positioning. In this work, we extend the differential positioning in GNSS to generalized differential positioning with OFDM satellite SOOPs, and propose a bandwidth-efficient framework to estimate the time difference of arrival (TDOA) at the reference node and the rover node. In this framework, the reference node estimates its own time of arrival (TOA) and shares partial subcarrier and symbol information with the rover node to help it achieve a better TOA estimation when its received signal is not strong enough, and the TDOA is obtained via subtraction. Then, a TOA estimation algorithm using only partial subcarriers and symbols of OFDM signals is proposed and the Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) of TOA estimation with parital data is derived. Subsequently, a data compression algorithm is proposed to minimize the transmission bits under the expected TDOA estimation accuracy and rover node's signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Simulations with Starlink downlink signals and 5G non-terrestrial network (NTN) downlink New Radio (NR) singals are conducted. The results show that the TOA estimation performance approaches the CRLB and a 10 picosecond-level TDOA performance is achievable with merely using 13% bits of the Starlink signal or using 34% bits of the 5G NR signal, which will bring about centimeter-level positioning if enough quantity of TDOAs are available.

data.title: Extremum encoding for joint baseband signal compression and time-delay estimation for distributed systems
data.abstractNote: The ubiquitous time-delay estimation (TDE) problem becomes nontrivial when sensors are non-co-located and communication between them is limited. Building on the recently proposed "extremum encoding" compression-estimation scheme, we address the critical extension to complex-valued signals, suitable for radio-frequency (RF) baseband processing. This extension introduces new challenges, e.g., due to unknown phase of the signal of interest and random phase of the noise, rendering a naïve application of the original scheme inapplicable and irrelevant. In the face of these challenges, we propose a judiciously adapted, though natural, extension of the scheme, paving its way to RF applications. While our extension leads to a different statistical analysis, including extremes of non-Gaussian distributions, we show that, ultimately, its asymptotic behavior is akin to the original scheme. We derive an exponentially tight upper bound on its error probability, corroborate our results via simulation experiments, and demonstrate the superior performance compared to two benchmark approaches.

data.title: A joint data compression and time-delay estimation method for distributed systems via extremum encoding
data.abstractNote: Motivated by the proliferation of mobile devices, we consider a basic form of the ubiquitous problem of time-delay estimation (TDE), but with communication constraints between two non co-located sensors. In this setting, when joint processing of the received signals is not possible, a compression technique that is tailored to TDE is desirable. For our basic TDE formulation, we develop such a joint compression-estimation strategy based on the notion of what we term "extremum encoding", whereby we send the index of the maximum of a finite-length time-series from one sensor to another. Subsequent joint processing of the encoded message with locally observed data gives rise to our proposed time-delay "maximum-index"-based estimator. We derive an exponentially tight upper bound on its error probability, establishing its consistency with respect to the number of transmitted bits. We further validate our analysis via simulations, and comment on potential extensions and generalizations of the basic methodology.

data.title: High-resolution one-bit direct position determination of narrowband gaussian emitters
data.abstractNote: The direct position determination (DPD) approach has been shown to be superior to alternative (two-steps) indirect methods for emitter localization in terms of the resulting accuracy. However, its requirement of joint raw data processing from all receiving non-co-located sensor arrays in different base stations results in one of its main drawbacks-that (all the) raw data be transferred to a common processor. To alleviate the communication requirements between the base stations, it has been recently proposed to use a coarsely quantized version of the raw data, specifically with one-bit-per-sample quantized measurements, for which the One-Bit DPD (OBDPD) method was developed. While OBDPD significantly reduces the requirements on the communication links between the base stations, similarly to classical DPD, it typically suffers from (substantially) degraded localization accuracy when multiple emitters are present in the area of interest. To tackle this limitation, we propose high-resolution OBDPD (HROBDPD), which is similar in nature to OBDPD, but with a minimum variance distortionless response approach. Despite the one-bit-per-sample quantization, HROB-DPD yields favorable spatial heat maps for the multiple-emitters case, thus leading to enhanced localization. Simulation results demonstrate the improved performance of HROBDPD relative to OBDPD in a scenario with more than a single emitter.

data.title: 基于深度学习的非合作辐射源位置感知技术研究与验证
data.abstractNote: 随着“一带一路”、“走出去”等国家战略的逐步推进,我国对于全天候、全地域的电磁频谱态势掌控能力提出了更为紧迫的要求。相较于感知范围受限的地基监测系统,以及轨道饱和、代价高昂的传统大卫星监测系统,基于微纳卫星构建低轨电磁监测星座系统,开展广域频谱感知,成为可选的最佳方案。频谱态势掌控的关键在于维护空间频率秩序,发现并剔除异常的频率信号,而非合作辐射源位置感知(无源定位)技术则是上述过程中的核心。由于低轨星座的广域覆盖与全球电子设备持续增长,系统面临的电磁数据呈海量化的发展。传统“星上采集与处理”的系统架构受限于卫星载荷性能与系统更迭成本,难以适应海量电磁数据下的高效无源定位。因此,本文以“星上采集与地面处理”系统架构为基础,针对传统方法处理地面海量数据的低效性问题,开展基于深度学习的非合作辐射源位置感知技术研究,具体成果如下:(1)针对当前研究未考虑定位问题中的频差信息与收发机位置坐标等信息而造成星座定位场景适用性与泛化性低下的问题,提出了一种基于深度学习的单目标端到端无源定位方案。利用卷积神经网络和全连接网络同时建模无源定位问题所有异构信息中的实数数据和时频图化的复数数据,实现了复杂电磁信号中的时差与频差信息的有效提取。并从公式归纳的角度论证了所提方法与传统直接定位法的一致性,给出了这一类方法的部分理论基础。实验结果表明,在各种信噪比与相似定位误差条件下,所提方法在同时考虑时频差信息的星座定位场景中,平均定位耗时为传统直接定位法的1%,并具有更低的定位虚警率。(2)针对当前研究未考虑实际定位场景中卫星接收到多个混叠信号和星座共视区域卫星数量动态变化的问题,在单目标定位研究的基础上,提出了一种适用于可变收发机条件下基于深度学习的多目标定位方法。利用零填充和排序不变训练策略解决了该定位场景下网络输入输出的匹配问题与排列问题,并公开了一个数据集以推动此定位场景下基于深度学习定位技术的发展。实验结果表明,所提方法在该定位场景下,定位误差与定位耗时分别是传统直接定位法的50%与2%。(3)针对当前研究使用现有图像处理网络作为定位基模型时,难以高效建模数据频域信息导致定位性能次优的问题,提出了一种基于自注意力机制与递减卷积结构相结合的模型架构。利用自注意力机制的低通滤波特性与递减卷积结构的高通滤波特性,实现了对数据中频域信息的高效建模功能。并探讨了Transformer性能与其多头注意力距离多样性之间的关系,为其后续性能的提升提供了新的思路。实验结果表明,在图像分类任务中,所提方法在模型性能与基线模型相同时,参数量和计算量分别是后者的29%与57%。在多目标定位任务中,与前文所提最优的方法相比,所提方法在定位误差相似条件下的定位耗时只有前者的49%,进一步提高了多目标的定位性能。

好的，博士生。我已经仔细阅读了你提供的论文摘录。这是一份颇有分量的博士论文，专注于分布式组网通感系统的直接定位技术，系统性地解决了实际部署中的多个关键瓶颈。下面我将按照你的要求，对你提供的文本进行详尽的分析和总结。

论文总结：分布式组网通感系统直接定位方法研究

1. 论文标题和摘要

论文标题：《分布式组网通感系统直接定位方法研究》

摘要总结：本文主要研究了分布式组网通感（ISAC）系统中的直接定位技术。该技术直接基于基带信号一步估计目标位置，相较于传统的两步定位法，在低信噪比下具有更高的精度和鲁棒性。论文针对系统实际部署中面临的通感信号互扰、通信带宽受限、非完美无线信道以及中央处理单元（CPU）单点故障风险四大挑战，进行了系统性的理论与方法研究。主要贡献包括：构建了系统的信号模型与预编码方案；提出了基于低比特量化的直接定位方法以解决带宽受限问题；针对离散误码信道和连续衰落信道，分别提出了基于硬解码和软解码的鲁棒定位方法；最后，为克服中心化架构的脆弱性，提出了一种去中心化的直接定位方法。仿真与实测结果验证了所提方法的有效性。

2. 引言

研究背景与动机：

  • 通感一体化（ISAC）：是6G的关键技术，旨在统一硬件平台和频谱资源，实现通信与感知功能的协同设计。
  • 分布式组网通感系统：是ISAC从单节点向多节点协作发展的必然趋势。通过在空间上广泛部署节点，该系统能够：
  • 通信层面：增强覆盖范围，缓解小区边缘效应。
  • 感知层面：利用多视角获取目标信息，抑制RCS闪烁，提升感知精度和稳健性。
  • 信号处理层面：通过联合处理信号获取空间分集增益，提升干扰抑制和系统容量。
  • 目标定位的核心地位：作为系统的核心功能，定位是实现基于位置服务的关键。
  • 直接定位 vs. 二次定位：
  • 二次定位（传统方法）：先由各节点独立估计中间参数（如到达角、到达时间），再由CPU根据几何关系解算目标位置。缺点是破坏了原始数据间的相关性，易受噪声影响，尤其在低SNR下性能不佳。
  • 直接定位（本文关注）：从基带信号出发，构建一步到位的目标位置估计器。优点是鲁棒性更高（不依赖中间参数估计）、低信噪比下性能优越、无需复杂的数据关联。
  • 研究目标：本文旨在解决分布式组网通感系统在实际应用中，直接定位技术面临的四个核心问题：
  1. 通感信号互扰：通信与感知信号共存时的干扰与资源分配。
  2. 通信带宽受限：大量感知节点需向CPU回传海量基带数据，带宽压力巨大。
  3. 非完美无线信道：前传链路（感知节点到CPU）的非理想性导致数据失真与误码。
  4. CPU单点故障：中心化融合架构下，CPU一旦失效，整个系统将瘫痪。
3. 正文部分

3.1 第二章：分布式组网通感系统模型构建与直接定位基础

  • 系统配置与工作模式:
  • 构建了一个多蜂窝、A发B收的ISAC系统模型，包括K个通感发射站（多天线）、L个感知接收机（单天线）和一个CPU。
  • 采用时分双工（TDD）协议，利用信道互易性进行信道估计。
  • 发射信号模型与预编码设计:
  • 发射信号由通信信号（承载数据）和专用感知波形组成。
  • 为了抑制节点内多用户干扰和感知信号对通信用户的干扰，设计了正则化迫零通信预编码和正交投影感知预编码。后者将感知波束发射方向投影到通信用户信道子空间的正交补上。
  • 该预编码设计实现了通信和感知波束在空间上的分离和资源分配。
  • 通信与感知接收模型:
  • 通信接收模型：信号包括期望信号、多用户干扰、感知信号干扰和噪声。
  • 感知接收模型：信号包括目标回波信号、通信用户反射干扰、直达径干扰和噪声。作者指出，在合作通信机制下，通过GPS或上行链路等技术，可以估计并抑制通信用户反射干扰和直达径干扰。
  • 经过干扰抑制后，感知接收信号模型被简化为仅包含目标回波和噪声的形式。
  • 直接定位方法基础:
  • 基于广义似然比检测（GLRT）准则，推导了动目标的直接定位估计器。核心思想是，通过求解信道系数的最大似然估计，将其代入对数似然比函数，最终得到仅与目标位置和速度相关的代价函数。通过简单的二维网格搜索即可求解。
  • 面临的挑战:
  • 系统性地引出了后续章节要解决的三个关键科学问题：通信带宽受限、非完美无线信道、中心化融合单点失效。
  • 仿真实验分析:
  • 预编码效果：验证了所提预编码方案能有效将能量聚焦在通信用户和目标方向，抑制干扰。
  • 通感性能权衡：展示了通信功率分配比例与通信SINR、感知波束增益之间的内在权衡。
  • 定位性能：与二次定位相比，所提直接定位在低SNR下具有显著的性能优势。

3.2 第三章：通信带宽受限下的分布式组网通感系统直接定位方法

  • 问题：大量感知接收机需传输完整基带信号至CPU，导致通信带宽瓶颈。
  • 解决方案：提出基于低比特量化的直接定位方法。
  • 核心机制：
  • 低通传输机制：每个感知接收机在本地对基带信号的实部和虚部分别进行低比特量化（如1-3比特），然后将量化后的信号传输至CPU。
  • 直接定位估计器：CPU利用低比特量化信号的概率质量函数（PMF） 构建最大似然估计器。这是一个高维、非凸优化问题，通过分步求解（先估计信道系数，再搜索目标位置）降低复杂度。
  • 性能分析：
  • 推导了所提方法的克拉美-罗下界（CRLB），为理论定位精度提供下界。
  • CRLB表明，定位性能受节点几何布局和量化阈值共同影响。
  • 低比特量化器设计：
  • 优化准则：以最小化CRLB为目标，优化量化阈值。
  • 求解算法：由于是高维非凸问题，提出了一种嵌入批量梯度下降（BGD）的粒子群优化（PSO）算法，以高效求解最优量化阈值。
  • 仿真与实测验证：
  • 仿真表明，3比特量化时的定位性能已接近全精度结果。算法性能随量化比特数、传感器数量和采样率增加而提升。
  • 实测数据（三台LFMCW雷达）验证了算法的实际可行性，证明低比特量化对基于相位信息的定位性能影响较小。

3.3 第四章：离散误码信道下的分布式组网通感系统直接定位方法

  • 问题：低比特数据经无线前传链路传输时，会因噪声和干扰产生误码（比特翻转）。
  • 解决方案：提出基于硬判决解码策略的低比特直接定位方法。
  • 模型构建：
  • 将无线信道建模为二进制对称信道（BSC），用误码率（BER） 刻画传输不确定性。
  • CPU接收信号的概率是本地量化信号概率与信道误码转移概率的加权和，并通过马尔可夫链建模。
  • 直接定位估计器：
  • CPU基于新构建的似然函数（考虑了BER），通过两步法求解：先求解信道系数（凸优化，梯度下降），再搜索目标位置。
  • 性能分析（CRLB）：推导了该方法在离散误码信道下的CRLB。
  • 量化器设计：
  • 发现目标定位精度主要受各节点时延估计精度影响。据此提出基于位置解耦的低维阈值优化方法，将高维联合优化问题分解为各节点独立的一维/低维优化子问题。
  • 一比特量化：证明了最优阈值可通过解析式求得（等于信号幅度的期望）。
  • 多比特量化：采用PSO算法进行求解。
  • 仿真分析：
  • 信道感知优势：验证了所提CA-DL（信道感知直接定位）方法在存在误码时，性能显著优于不考虑信道失真的NonCA-DL方法。
  • 量化器效果：所提的优化量化方法LOPD性能优于均匀量化，尤其在多比特场景。
  • 健壮性分析：分析了BER估计误差对性能的影响，指出其具有敏感性，但通过现有技术可获得足够精确的BER估计。

3.4 第五章：连续衰落信道下的分布式组网通感系统直接定位方法

  • 问题：将非完美信道模型从离散误码推广到更实际的连续瑞利衰落信道。
  • 解决方案：提出基于软判决解码策略的一比特直接定位方法。
  • 模型构建：
  • 建立“本地感知层-无线信道层（瑞利衰落）-CPU层”的三层信息处理架构。
  • 在CPU侧，采用软解码策略，不像硬解码那样直接做0/1判决，而是基于接收信号的连续概率分布进行推理。
  • 直接定位估计器：
  • 推导了相位相干接收和非相干接收（能量检测） 两种软解码策略下的似然函数。
  • 针对高维非凸优化问题，提出了一种基于上界最小化的高效求解算法，将原本耦合的参数（如目标位置与信道系数）解耦，实现低维迭代求解。
  • 性能分析（CRLB）：分别推导了两种解码策略下的CRLB。
  • 量化器设计：
  • 将阈值优化问题从全局最小化CRLB，转化为各局部节点最大化其时延估计的Fisher信息。
  • 针对强非线性问题，提出了一种改进的Barzilai-Borwein梯度下降（MBB-GD）方法，在保持收敛速度的同时，增强了在非凸问题上的稳定性和有效性。
  • 仿真分析：
  • 解码策略：相干解码性能优于非相干解码，因其利用了信道相位信息。
  • 性能对比：所提OBDL方法在极少节点（9个） 下的性能，超越了两步方法OBTL在更多节点（如48个） 下的性能，充分体现了直接定位的优势。
  • 衰落影响：验证了衰落方差越小，性能越接近理想信道。
  • 阈值设计：在高低SNR下，所提优化阈值方案均表现出色，而固定阈值方案在高SNR下会失效。

3.5 第六章：去中心融合架构下的分布式组网通感系统直接定位方法

  • 问题：中心化架构存在CPU单点故障风险，且通信开销和灵活性受限。
  • 解决方案：提出一种去中心化直接定位（DDL） 方法，分为本地估计（LE） 和融合更新（FU） 两个阶段。
  • LE阶段：
  • 每个感知节点基于自身接收信号，并考虑节点间时钟异步（存在未知时钟偏移），独立构建本地直接定位估计器。
  • 为解决本地高维非凸优化问题，设计了一种基于信赖域策略的轻量级迭代求解器（Levenberg-Marquardt类方法），稳定且高效。
  • FU阶段：
  • 提出一种基于加权共识的去中心化信息融合策略。
  • 节点间仅交换低维参数信息（如Fisher信息矩阵和梯度向量），而非原始基带数据，极大降低了通信开销。
  • 权重由节点的局部Fisher信息决定，信息质量高的节点在融合时被赋予更高权重。
  • 设计了一种基于Fisher信息迹的节点调度策略，只选择信息贡献大的节点参与融合，进一步提升效率。
  • 性能分析：
  • 从收敛性、CRLB、计算复杂度和通信开销四个方面进行了全面分析。
  • 证明了所提共识策略的收敛性。
  • 仿真分析：
  • 共识收敛：展示了各节点通过共识迭代，收敛到与中心化方法一致的稳态解的过程。
  • 融合策略：所提Fisher信息加权策略优于最大度、相关度等传统策略。
  • 定位性能：在不同SNR和时钟偏移条件下，DDL性能均显著优于DLS、ADTSL、ADPD等现有去中心化算法，并逼近中心化CRLB。时钟估计精度也高于两步法。

详细问题回答

Q1: 这篇论文试图解决什么问题？

A1: 这篇论文试图解决分布式组网通感（ISAC）系统在实际部署中，应用直接定位技术时面临的四个核心挑战：

  1. 通感信号互扰问题：多蜂窝 ISAC 系统中，通信与感知信号共存导致的空间干扰与资源分配问题。
  2. 通信带宽受限问题：大量感知节点需向中央处理单元（CPU）回传海量基带信号，导致前传链路通信带宽压力巨大。
  3. 非完美无线信道问题：感知节点与 CPU 之间的无线前传链路存在噪声、衰落和干扰，导致回传的（量化）数据发生失真与误码，严重影响定位性能。
  4. 中心化融合单点故障问题：传统中心化融合架构高度依赖 CPU，存在单点故障风险，且在大规模动态网络中灵活性和鲁棒性不足。

(张国鑫, 2026)

Q2: 这是一个新问题吗？

A2: 不完全是。 直接定位、低比特量化、非完美信道下的融合、去中心化定位等都已分别被研究过。但是，这篇论文的新颖性在于将这些问题在分布式组网 ISAC 系统这一特定且重要的框架下进行系统性整合与联合优化。

具体而言，本工作的新意体现在：

  • 问题组合的新颖性：以往研究通常只处理其中一两个挑战。例如，有的工作专注于直接定位本身（假设理想信道），有的专注于量化融合（通常用于两步法）。而本文同时考虑了通感信号干扰、带宽限制、信道非理想性和去中心化架构这四重约束，这是一个更贴近现实、更全面的问题设定。
  • 视角的独特性：将直接定位方法，而不是两步法，作为核心，并围绕它来解决上述所有挑战。这是对现有研究方向的深化和拓展。

(张国鑫, 2026)

Q3: 这篇论文试图验证什么科学假设？

A3: 这篇论文尝试验证一系列环环相扣的科学假设，核心可以概括为：

  1. 在分布式组网ISAC系统中，直接定位方法在鲁棒性与低信噪比下的性能优势，依然成立且可以通过技术手段实现。

data.title: Consistent and asymptotically efficient localization using differential received signal strength
data.abstractNote: We study the problem of signal source localization using differential received signal strength (DRSS) measurements. We begin by presenting verifiable geometric conditions for sensor deployment that ensure the model’s asymptotic localizability. Then we establish the consistency and asymptotic efficiency of the maximum likelihood (ML) estimator. However, computing the ML estimator is challenging due to relying on solving a non-convex optimization problem. To address this, we propose an asymptotically efficient two-step estimator that matches the ML estimator’s asymptotic properties while achieving low computational complexity (linear in the number of measurements). The primary challenge lies in obtaining a preliminary consistent estimate in the first step. To achieve this, we construct a linear least-squares (LS) problem through algebraic operations on the nonlinear measurement model to obtain a closed-form solution. This solution is biased due to the correlation between the regressors and the noise of the linear model.We eliminate the bias using the data to yield an asymptotically unbiased and consistent estimate. In the second step, we perform a single Gauss-Newton (GN) iteration using the preliminary consistent estimate as the initial value, achieving the same asymptotic properties as the ML estimator. Finally, simulation results demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed two-step estimator over existing methods for large sample sizes.
data.extra: abstractTranslation: 本研究探讨了利用差分接收信号强度（DRSS）测量进行信号源定位的问题。我们首先提出了验证传感器部署的几何条件，以确保模型的渐近可定位性。接着，我们证明了最大似然（ML）估计的一致性和渐近效率。然而，由于需要求解非凸优化问题，计算ML估计存在挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个渐近有效的两步估计器，该估计器在保持ML估计渐近特性的同时，实现了低计算复杂度（测量数量呈线性）。主要挑战在于第一步中获得初步的一致估计。为此，我们通过对非线性测量模型进行代数运算构建线性最小二乘（LS）问题，以获得闭式解。该解因回归变量与线性模型噪声的相关性而存在偏差。我们利用数据进行消除偏差处理，从而得到渐近无偏且一致估计。第二步中，我们以初步一致估计为初值，执行一次高斯-牛顿（GN）迭代，最终获得与ML估计器相同的渐近特性。最后，仿真结果表明，对于大样本量，所提出的两步估计器在性能上优于现有方法。

data.title: Calibration-target-assisted multistatic localization and synchronization: a computationally efficient multi-stage solution using TD measurements
data.abstractNote: This letter presents a multi-stage solution to the calibration-target-assisted multistatic localization problem based on time delay (TD) measurements, in the presence of unknown receiver clock drifts and offsets caused by clock imperfections. In the first stage, the common clock offset is mitigated by differencing the direct and indirect-path TD measurements from the calibration target, providing a weighted least squares (WLS) estimate of the clock drift. In the second stage, the previously obtained drift estimate is used along with the direct-path measurements to produce the closed-form estimate of the transformed clock offset. In the third stage, localization is achieved by solving a constrained WLS problem constructed using these estimates together with the indirect-path TD measurements related to the unknown target. Simulations confirm that, in the small-noise/large-receiver regime, the resulting target position estimate approaches the Cramèr–Rao lower bound (CRLB) corresponding to the joint estimator that utilizes the complete measurement set.
data.shortTitle: Calibration-target-assisted multistatic localization and synchronization
